bugsFixed.description: FIXED: IndentationError in courier/orchestrator.py except block — the except clause body at line 175 was not indented under the except statement after cache wiring code was added around the fetch call
bugsFixed.rootCause: When cache-check code (store.read_cached_html) was added wrapping the try/except for fetcher.fetch_article, the except block body was left at the original indentation level instead of being indented one additional level to be inside the new else clause
bugsFixed.fixDescription: Indented the entire except block body (lines 175-190) by one additional level to be properly nested under the except clause within the else branch

bugsFixed.description: FIXED: Missing mock_store.read_cached_html.return_value = None in test_permanent_skip_after_max_attempts — without this, mock_store.read_cached_html returns a truthy MagicMock, causing the code to skip the fetch path entirely and go to extraction
bugsFixed.rootCause: After cache wiring was added to _process_article(), tests that mock store need to explicitly set read_cached_html.return_value = None to force the fetch-from-network path (per INTRODUCTION.md Testing Pattern 2). This test was missing that setup line.
bugsFixed.fixDescription: Added mock_store.read_cached_html.return_value = None to the test setup
